execution_queue.purpose: Test four frozen residual readouts around the same current Q1; distinguish linear, displacement-only nonlinear and endpoint nonlinear value.
execution_queue.fit: Fixed Q1. CAL-only shared projections/normalization and fixed regularization rule; convex residual readout. All residual arms include C=0 as the exact same Q1.
execution_queue.controls: Common Q1 base; 64x32=2048 residual readout coefficients per arm, with costs/effective capacity reported separately. Do not claim all capacities or costs match.
execution_queue.code_checks: C=0 prediction identity, CAL aggregate penalized objective no worse than zero in the mathematical fit, gate/basis semantics, actual BF16 replay in the same experiment.
execution_queue.stop: No useful source-wise DEV benefit => stop this residual version; no automatic rank/activation/lambda/data expansion.
execution_queue.promotion: Only a useful candidate proceeds to purpose-bound full80/export/video validation. Tiny positive local error change is not automatic promotion.

execution_queue.purpose: Bind original/distilled FFN weights, exact method implementations and available full-M statistics; inspect prior O40 state support.
execution_queue.next_action: Locate and verify identities and actual payload availability; no regeneration merely to recover missing published receipts.

execution_queue.purpose: Conditional weight dependence of the three specified methods on common D4 endpoint states and a fixed reference gate.
execution_queue.target: For each W separately recompute F_W(U_anchor), F_W(U_hit) and all weight-dependent method caches; never use W_D targets for W_O.

methods.Q1: Same fixed Q1r2 learning rule with each-W CAL11 parameters; reuse W_D only on exact matching identity.
methods.ICC: ICC_SVD_R512_TWO_RESIDUAL; ordinary SVD r512, intermediate GELU and two-residual numerical/cache semantics. Not CD-SVD.
methods.Chipmunk: Bind fixed selector/mask/budget/cache version first. Historical global-P64 and author full-M selector are distinct identities; full-M comparison requires actual B_CHIP_FULLM_STATS.

execution_queue.fit: Equal CAL source/row budget across weights. Refit each method only where its rule is data-dependent; ordinary weight-only SVD does not require artificial CAL fitting.
execution_queue.partial_completion: Q1/ICC can finish while the Chipmunk cell is BLOCKED_MISSING_FULLM_STATS. Never label two-method results a completed three-method comparison.
execution_queue.claim: Weight-conditioned method gaps for the exact tested implementations; not equal-latency superiority, pure distillation causality or Wan-unique architecture causality.

conditional_branches.purpose: Weight-by-native-state-distribution interaction; distinguish it from a matched pure interval claim.
conditional_branches.trigger: The established weight-versus-state/interval question remains unresolved after B-W; independent of A success and of the sign of the B-W contrast.
conditional_branches.cost: O40 is separately budgeted; CFG branches and replay/fit costs are not hidden in a D4 count.
conditional_branches.preparation: BWS_PREPARE is the support/recipe check phase of this conditional task, not an automatic separate model experiment.
conditional_branches.fit: For each W fit once on the same CAL3 mixture (D256+O256 per source); score all four DEV cells with fixed theta(W) and G_ref. Distinct identity from CAL11 B-W.
conditional_branches.support: Bind legal pre-W1 dimensions, source roles, token correspondence, within-expert native endpoint pairs and native O scheduler/CFG. Actual noise/gap overlap governs matched component attribution.
conditional_branches.state_claim: mu_O/mu_D are composite native state/interval/CFG distributions. Four-cell interaction is not pure step-count causality or each model own-best native deployment quality.
conditional_branches.no_overlap: No fabricated nearest-time matching. Without noise/gap overlap, report only the composite-distribution contrast; the pure interval/component effect remains UNIDENTIFIED.
conditional_branches.invalid_interface: If legal same-interface/within-expert pairing or source binding fails, do not execute affected cells.
conditional_branches.chipmunk: A full-M selector cell in this stage needs its own O-state statistics; do not recycle D-state masks. Capture them in the same already-needed O rollout when required.

v4_result_bounded.ranking: Q1 best; constrained readouts WORSE than Q1 by 3.88%-5.52%; among constrained L64_Q32 closest to Q1, then ENDPOINT_N32 < DELTA_N32 < L32.
v4_result_bounded.interpretation: Q1 and all four constrained models improve in absolute DEV MSE with more CAL rows; Q1 improves most; free-linear worsens (overfit). source_density_delta (delta r) measures gap-to-Q1 change, not absolute effectiveness.
v4_result_bounded.mechanism_bounds: Free uses Q1 base, constrained use Q0 base; cross-family attribution is confounded. L64 matches readout parameter count, not total feature/cost capacity, and beats Endpoint on 11/11 DEV sources. No unique endpoint-information or degrees-of-freedom causal claim follows.

doc_rev2_corrections.floor: Published floor is total BF16 replay-vs-dense error (model + rounding), not pure rounding noise. The 11/11 unmeasurable claim is retracted in the report. No standalone recomputation is scheduled; a future chosen predictor would include an actual BF16-vs-math check in its own deployment comparison.
